summary: Jinxin Technology Holding Co (NASDAQ: NAMI), a Cayman-incorporated Shanghai-based education services issuer, filed a 6-K disclosing an Economic Interest Transfer Agreement dated September 15, 2026 with HK Education Vision Holding Co., Limited (seller) and Yuanwei Network Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. (target). Jinxin acquires economic interests in 40% of the seller's equity in the target for RMB14,301,664.20, paid via 284,372,086 ordinary shares (par US$0.00001428571428), implying roughly RMB0.0503 per share. Board approved; closing expected September 15, 2026, subject to customary conditions; shares locked up six months. Watch dilution and closing mechanics.
